newsitem.title: USA: Terra says got some normally Q2 sales in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Terra says got some normally Q2 sales in Q3.

text.p: Terra Industries Inc said it gained in the third quarter some sales that normally occur in the second quarter due to a delayed planting season.

The fertilizer, crop protection products, seed and agricultural services firm said, "While earnings from our distribution business were higher this year than last, overall results from that business were mixed."

In the nitrogen business, higher revenues than in 1995 came on the start-up of a plant that boosted nitrogen solution sales. "However, lower prices for all nitrogen fertilizer products reduced operating income," Terra said.
The methanol business benefited from strengthening prices and an increase in sales volume in this quarter compared with last year's results, the company said.

The company on Monday reported net income of $23.9 million, or $0.32 per share, on revenues of $471.5 million for the quarter ended September 30. This compares with net income of $24.9 million, or $0.31 per share, on revenues of $492.3 million for the comparable quarter in 1995.
